title: Alex Zastre
description: Alex Zastre is a dynamic leader and seasoned financial strategist, serving as Managing Partner at White Swan Advisors. With a career marked by innovation and precision, Alex brings extensive expertise in investment banking, capital raising, and financial strategy, making him an invaluable asset to the firm.

As a Registered Representative of Finalis Securities LLC (FINRA/SIPC), Alex exemplifies compliance excellence, seamlessly blending regulatory proficiency with cutting-edge financial solutions. His deep understanding of FINRA regulations and commitment to ethical standards ensures that every transaction is executed with precision, transparency, and trust.

Alex spearheaded groundbreaking transactions and forged transformative partnerships. His ability to navigate complex financial landscapes and deliver tailored solutions has earned him a reputation as a results-driven professional who consistently exceeds client expectations.

Alex’s leadership is defined by a relentless commitment to client success, ensuring that every engagement is tailored to maximize value and create lasting impact. With a global outlook and a meticulous approach, Alex Zastre stands as a cornerstone of White Swan Advisors’ mission to deliver transformative results for businesses worldwide.

title: Louis Garoz-Ferguson
description: Louis Garoz-Ferguson is an accomplished investment banker and dealmaker with a unique edge—his deep expertise in marketing. As Managing Partner of White Swan Advisors, a premier lower-middle market capital advisory firm and merchant bank, Louis has led his team to achieve billions in aggregate transaction volume. His ability to seamlessly integrate advanced marketing strategies into the world of capital markets sets him apart, enabling businesses to not only secure capital but also enhance their market presence.

Louis’s marketing acumen drives White Swan Advisors’ success, where he applies strategic insights to growth capital, debt advisory, and corporate finance. His hands-on approach to crafting investor materials, developing compelling narratives, and positioning businesses for growth has been instrumental in achieving transformative results for his clients.

With a background that spans high-stakes finance, including managing significant gold bullion transactions, Louis has proven his expertise across industries. His strength lies in marrying financial strategy with marketing prowess, ensuring every transaction is backed by a compelling narrative and strategic positioning that resonates with investors.

Louis’s innovative approach to deal-making and his unparalleled marketing expertise have solidified White Swan Advisors as a trusted leader in the financial sector, consistently delivering exceptional outcomes for businesses worldwide.
